about: dash-gui's application mutants (wf10 corpus wave GP4a): edits of the example, each with the law or the test that kills it. A killer examples/dash-gui/PKG:law L is `ergo test examples/dash-gui/PKG --law L`; cmd/ergo:TestDashGuiAgreesWithControl is the seeded agreement property against the one-loop reference model and the hand Go control, which kills the mutants no law sees.

mutants.name: dash-ring-overwrites-one-slot
mutants.rule: A ring holds the last N values pushed, oldest first.

mutants.name: dash-column-skips-its-last-sample
mutants.rule: A chart's columns keep the samples' least and greatest value.

mutants.name: dash-ease-runs-backwards
mutants.rule: An ease moves from its origin toward its target and never back.

mutants.name: dash-stale-one-frame-early
mutants.rule: A live panel is live up to StaleAfter frames after its last sample and stale at the next.

mutants.name: dash-drop-newest-uncounted
mutants.rule: A sample a full queue drops is counted as dropped.

mutants.name: dash-queue-one-short
mutants.rule: A queue holds cap samples before it drops.

mutants.name: dash-sample-out-of-range
mutants.rule: A sample is from 0 to panel.Top.

mutants.name: dash-newest-writes-oldest
mutants.rule: A command's line reads back as the command.

mutants.name: dash-takes-a-plus-sign
mutants.rule: A number in a script is digits only.

mutants.name: dash-gauge-jumps
mutants.rule: A gauge eases from where it is shown, not from its last target.

mutants.name: dash-log-takes-the-alarm-level
mutants.rule: The log writes the samples above the alarm level.

mutants.name: dash-clock-before-samples
mutants.rule: A panel takes a frame's samples before the frame's tick, so samples that come on the stale bound keep it live.

mutants.name: dash-stale-cannot-pause
mutants.rule: A stale panel can be paused.

mutants.name: dash-gauge-shows-its-origin
mutants.rule: A gauge shows its eased value at the frame.

mutants.name: dash-heat-loses-the-top-bin
mutants.rule: A heat strip's bins are even.

mutants.name: dash-policy-ignored
mutants.rule: A policy command sets what the source's queue drops.

mutants.name: dash-drops-uncounted
mutants.rule: The board counts every sample a queue dropped.
